analysis.reasonEn: RSI rose from 31.6 to 45.1, exiting oversold territory. MACD histogram improved from -3.2783 to -1.5622, signaling bottoming. Volume ratio at 0.43 for 5 consecutive days indicates contraction. Current price $728.32 shows recovery from 5-day low of $686.75. 52-week position at 65.0%. Price is -0.36% relative to SMA200, indicating a neutral zone. ADX at 25.1 suggests a clear trend is forming, but -DI at 37.8 is stronger than +DI at 18.2, indicating downward pressure. Weekly RSI is 46.8 and weekly MACD histogram is -8.5752, showing weakness. While daily charts show recovery signals, lack of volume and weekly weakness prevent confirmation of a trend reversal. Therefore, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
